Pending/running intervals are derived from recorded start/end times; recorded outputs appear only at their end time. This is not a frame-exact browser recording. No new inference runs.
provenance.recordedObservationsSource: All persisted SNAPSHOT records in the final captured partition, restricted to their allowed lastObservation. This independent timeline does not add or alter sampled frames, model decisions, or cumulative metrics.
provenance.observationTimeOrigin: Elapsed milliseconds from the original session start; a negative value identifies an observation saved before the replay started.
provenance.eventAndDecisionTimeline: The final frame contains the complete captured events, assessments and activity records with original timestamps. Their timestamps can support a future derived replay; unsampled intermediate model decisions and cumulative metric totals have not been invented.
provenance.modelOutputs: Recorded structured decisions, proposed findings and published advisory text; no private chain of thought or unpersisted model responses.

captureProvenance.timelineNote: Recorded real Decider and Bedrock inference on a fictional scripted ATC scenario. Frames are observed persisted revisions, not a continuous browser recording. Short transitions between polls may be absent. Aircraft display uses the latest persisted scenario-allowed observation.
captureProvenance.recordedObservationsSource: All persisted SNAPSHOT records in the final captured partition, restricted to their allowed lastObservation. This independent timeline does not add or alter sampled frames, model decisions, or cumulative metrics.
captureProvenance.observationTimeOrigin: Elapsed milliseconds from the original session start; a negative value identifies an observation saved before the replay started.
captureProvenance.eventAndDecisionTimeline: The final frame contains the complete captured events, assessments and activity records with original timestamps. Their timestamps can support a future derived replay; unsampled intermediate model decisions and cumulative metric totals have not been invented.
captureProvenance.modelOutputs: Recorded structured decisions, proposed findings and published advisory text; no private chain of thought or unpersisted model responses.

provenance.metricsNote: Decider and activity durations are the original measured results. Cumulative Bedrock token totals and incomplete-usage flags change only at original capture samples; no intermediate token counts are estimated.
provenance.observationNote: Positions are held from the latest saved allowed observation. Simulation time advances only at recorded time anchors; neither hidden aircraft state nor interpolated movement is used.
